name: Makishima Tantei Jimusho Monogatari ~Shinsou no Malice~
original_name: 牧島探偵事務所物語 ～深窓のマリス～
source:
Early Showa era...

A Western-style mansion stands alone in a remote rural area.
Every night, pleasurable affairs happen here. One night, something strange happens.

A letter of request arrives to the protagonist, who runs a detective agency in the imperial capital of Tokyo.

"My life is in danger, and I want you to uncover a conspiracy..."

(Translated from [url=http://www013.upp.so-net.ne.jp/atelier_yohkiro/tantei/tantei.html]official website[/url])
translation:
昭和初期…

一栋西式洋楼孤零零地矗立在偏僻的乡村。
每天晚上，这里都会发生令人愉快的事情。一天晚上，发生了一件奇怪的事情。

在帝都东京经营一家侦探社的主角收到了一封委托信。

“我有生命危险，我要你揭开一个阴谋……”

（翻译自[url=http://www013.upp.so-net.ne.jp/atelier_yohkiro/tantei/tantei.html]官网[/url]）
